disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Similar symptoms can have non-disease causes. Confirm diagnosis with a KVK, agricultural extension officer, or plant pathologist. Use only products registered for the crop and disease locally and follow the current label.

symptoms: Older leaves show target-like brown spots and yellowing
Stems and fruit develop dark sunken lesions
prevention: Rotate crops, stake plants, mulch, and use clean transplants
Water at soil level and maintain nutrition
treatment: Remove affected lower leaves and disinfect tools
Use a registered fungicide only under local advice
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Water-soaked leaf lesions rapidly become brown
White edge growth appears in humidity; fruit develops firm brown rot
prevention: Use healthy transplants and resistant varieties
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness and monitor forecasts
treatment: Isolate suspected plants and act urgently
Use a registered anti-oomycete program with expert guidance
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Many small circular spots with grey centres and dark margins
Tiny black fruiting bodies appear; lower leaves yellow and drop
prevention: Stake, mulch, and avoid overhead irrigation
treatment: Use a registered protectant fungicide if local advice supports it
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: One side or lower leaves yellow and wilt
Stem vascular tissue shows brown discoloration
prevention: Use resistant varieties and clean transplants
Rotate, sanitize tools, and manage soil movement
treatment: Remove infected plants and plan resistant varieties or grafting
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: V-shaped yellow lesions develop from leaf margins
Plants wilt and vascular tissue becomes light brown
prevention: Use resistant varieties and clean plants
Rotate with non-host crops and control susceptible weeds
treatment: Remove plants and improve long-term soil and rotation management
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Small dark greasy leaf spots may have yellow halos
prevention: Use tested seed and clean transplants
Avoid overhead irrigation and handling wet plants
treatment: Remove badly affected plants and sanitize tools
Ask extension services about locally effective registered bactericides
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails
